source.caption: A. Two-dimensional structure of the PFOA molecule. B. Venn diagram of potential PFOA targets predicted by ChEMBL, STITCH, and SwissTargetPrediction databases. C. PCA plot of the training dataset before merging. D. PCA plot of the dataset after merging and batch correction. E. Volcano plot of differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in the NAFLD group. F. Venn diagram of overlapping disease genes from four databases (GEO, OMIM, GeneCard, TTD). G. Venn diagram of intersecting genes between PFOA and NAFLD, and the hub gene network.
